minedSpec:
# PROPOSED rules, mined from the code (daedalus mine-rules; src/rule-mining). Not a reviewed spec: review before use.
# style: hexagonal (ISE, confidence 1.00); layers: ISE preset-first
# mined rules: 21 (20 emitted)
# MR-001 [layer-direction, high 0.82] domain must not depend on application (13 edges application -> domain; 0/8 domain files import application)
# MR-002 [layer-direction, low 0.44] domain must not depend on adapters-inbound (1 edges adapters-inbound -> domain; 0/8 domain files import adapters-inbound)
# MR-003 [layer-direction, high 0.76] domain must not depend on adapters-outbound (6 edges adapters-outbound -> domain; 0/8 domain files import adapters-outbound)
# MR-004 [layer-unobserved, low 0.22] domain must not depend on config (no import between them either way)
# MR-005 [layer-direction, high 0.77] application must not depend on adapters-inbound (5 edges adapters-inbound -> application; 0/12 application files import adapters-inbound)
# MR-006 [layer-direction, high 0.77] application must not depend on adapters-outbound (5 edges adapters-outbound -> application; 0/12 application files import adapters-outbound)
# MR-007 [layer-direction, medium 0.69] application must not depend on config (3 edges config -> application; 0/12 application files import config)
# MR-008 [layer-rare-edge, low 0.30] adapters-inbound should not depend on domain (1/4 adapters-inbound files imports it; nothing goes back) -- 1 exception(s): src/plugins/entry/http/BookingController.ts -> src/kernel/errors/BookingError.ts
# MR-009 [layer-unobserved, low 0.33] adapters-inbound must not depend on adapters-outbound (no import between them either way)
# MR-010 [layer-direction, medium 0.60] adapters-inbound must not depend on config (3 edges config -> adapters-inbound; 0/4 adapters-inbound files import config)
# MR-011 [layer-unobserved, low 0.33] adapters-outbound must not depend on adapters-inbound (no import between them either way)
# MR-012 [layer-direction, medium 0.69] adapters-outbound must not depend on config (5 edges config -> adapters-outbound; 0/5 adapters-outbound files import config)
# MR-013 [layer-unobserved, low 0.22] config must not depend on domain (no import between them either way)
# MR-014 [acyclic-files, high 0.97] no file lies on an import cycle (30/30 files do not)
# MR-015 [component-direction, high 0.82] folder component kernel must not depend on orchestration (13 imports orchestration -> kernel; 0/8 files import back)
# MR-016 [component-direction, high 0.78] folder component kernel must not depend on plugins (7 imports plugins -> kernel; 0/8 files import back)
# MR-017 [component-direction, medium 0.69] folder component orchestration must not depend on setup (3 imports setup -> orchestration; 0/12 files import back)
# MR-018 [component-direction, high 0.84] folder component orchestration must not depend on plugins (10 imports plugins -> orchestration; 0/12 files import back)
# MR-019 [component-direction, high 0.80] folder component plugins must not depend on setup (8 imports setup -> plugins; 0/9 files import back)
# MR-020 [port-implementation, high 0.75] every *Repository class in adapters-outbound implements an interface declared in another layer (3/3)
# MR-021 [inject-abstractions, high 0.80] classes of adapters-inbound inject interfaces across layers, not concrete classes (4/4) -- not emitted: the existing templates check the application-kind layer only (application), not adapters-inbound

spec_version: "1.0.0"

architecture:
  style: hexagonal

  layers:
    - name: domain
      kind: domain
      directories:
        - src/kernel/**
      roles:
        - entity
        - value-object
        - domain-service
        - port

    - name: application
      kind: application
      directories:
        - src/orchestration/**
      roles:
        - use-case
        - port
        - application-service

    - name: adapters-inbound
      kind: presentation
      directories:
        - src/plugins/entry/**
      roles:
        - controller
        - cli-command
        - message-consumer

    - name: adapters-outbound
      kind: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/plugins/exit/**
      roles:
        - repository
        - gateway
        - external-api-client

    # Composition root: wires adapters to ports. kind application is only a placeholder for the kind resolver.
    - name: config
      kind: application
      directories:
        - src/setup/**
      roles:
        - composition-root
        - module

  # `from` may import each layer in `to`; any other cross-layer import is a violation.
  allowed_dependencies:
    # observed: application -> domain 8/12 files
    - from: application
      to:
        - domain
    # observed: adapters-inbound -> application 3/4 files
    - from: adapters-inbound
      to:
        - application
    # observed: adapters-outbound -> application 5/5 files; adapters-outbound -> domain 4/5 files
    - from: adapters-outbound
      to:
        - application
        - domain
    # observed: config -> adapters-inbound 1/1 files; config -> adapters-outbound 1/1 files; config -> application 1/1 files
    - from: config
      to:
        - adapters-inbound
        - adapters-outbound
        - application
